environment.description: Container deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster with Pod Security Standard 'restricted' enforcement. The pod spec sets securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true at container level. No emptyDir, hostPath, or tmpfs volumeMounts are defined in the pod manifest. The node uses containerd with default snapshotter (overlayfs) and the pod's ephemeral storage limit is set to 0. GKE Autopilot additionally enforces that no writable volume of any type can be mounted when readOnlyRootFilesystem is true unless explicitly declared. The container's /tmp resolves to the read-only overlay upper layer which returns EROFS on any write syscall. Note: the file lock acquisition and cache directory creation will both fail with OSError, causing the tool to exit before reaching the vulnerable TOCTOU window.
